Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted “Buenos Aires” (the documented place of death) as “Buenos Aires Province” and unjustifiably specified the city as La Plata. This conflation between the autonomous city of Buenos Aires and the province led to proposing an unsupported death location, deviating from authoritative sources that consistently list Buenos Aires.
